predictions.source_summary: Property names come from user input via expression parsing - either as string literals from parseStringToken() or symbols from token parsing in parseObject() function
predictions.sink_summary: Used in ObjectNode compilation to validate property keys before generating JavaScript code, preventing access to dangerous inherited properties like constructor/toString
predictions.guard_summary: The function itself is the guard - it checks if property exists on empty object prototype using 'prop in {}' test. This prevents prototype pollution and access to inherited methods.
predictions.risk_pattern: User-supplied property names are validated against object prototype inheritance to prevent prototype pollution and unauthorized access to inherited object methods during expression compilation
enclosing_conditions: Called for each property key during object compilation
predictions.context_summary: Security function added to prevent prototype pollution and unauthorized property access in mathematical expression evaluation. Validates that user-supplied property names don't conflict with inherited Object prototype properties.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
top_sast_rules.description: Attacker-controlled object keys modify Object prototype attributes.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-1321 prototype-pollution __proto__ constructor prototype object-key property-key merge assign recursive-merge
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject prototype keys and use schema-constrained object updates.
